back to C in the general targets %.o.

- Bob

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: checked in autocorrelation; broke build
parts:
On 5/25/12 2:04 AM, Ben Goodrich wrote:
> test-unit seems fine here too. Also, I didn't really follow the FFT discussion, so perhaps this has already been
> addressed. But eigen already has a FFT module in unsupported/ based on KISS, so why are we rolling our own here?

It's not quite rolling our own. Just a wrapper
around Kiss FFT's forward and reverse transforms.

Eigen rewrote Kiss FFT rather than just wrapping
it.

We only need to compute autocorrelations.

We could base this on Eigen's unsupported module,
but it looks like it hasn't been touched since 2009.
We haven't included the code for their unsupported
mods, but we could.

The basic Eigen interface looks nicer -- more C++-ish.
Oddly, they went with std::vector rather than
an Eigen vector type.

The results are a bit different, but that shouldn't
matter.

I'm happy to do it either way.

- Bob
